title: Uruguayan Tofu Stew
description: A comforting and umami-rich stew featuring garlic and tofu, perfect for a sick day. This vegan-friendly dish is inspired by Uruguayan cuisine.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat using a bain-marie.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the cubed tofu and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the vegetable broth, tomato paste, smoked paprika, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
